name: unslop-vscode
description: Scan your local changes for AI slop and apply approved fixes — powered by the unslop CLI.

unslop.cliPath.description: Path to the unslop CLI binary. Leave empty to use 'unslop' from PATH.

unslop.apiKey.markdownDescription: Gatekeeper API key (usk_…). Prefer `unslop login` — this setting is stored in plain text and overrides the CLI config.

unslop.baseUrl.description: Gatekeeper backend URL. Leave empty for the CLI default.
